description.value:
Your ability to talk with the world around you is more than just sympathetic feeling; you can have full conversations among the flowers, rocks, and birds. While you're often expected to serve as a mediator between the river and the waterfall, you might take that role seriously, or you might shirk it. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Speak with Animals] as an occult innate spell at will.

In addition, once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Speak with Plants], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Speak with Stones], or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Speak With Water] as an occult innate spell. You choose which spell you cast each time you use this ability.
